newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-C-C Amatil shares slide continues.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-C-C Amatil shares slide continues.

text.p: Shares in softdrink bottler Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd fell a further 99 cents in morning trade on Wednesday to A$11.20 as the market continued its sharp sell-down.
"There is at least one analyst around town, and maybe more, that is very, very bearish on C-C Amatil...and it seems obviously to be carrying a bit of weight," said a senior Sydney broker.
C-C Amatil has fallen A$2.46, or about 18 percent, since releasing its preliminary results for the year to December 31, 1996 late on Friday.
First Pacific Stockbrokers, which has been bearish on C-C Amatil, has revised down its valuation of the company to A$10.20 per share since the release of the results.
This figure included A$1.00 for potential franchise acquisitons in emerging markets, said Mike Jenneke of First Pacific's food and retail analyst team.
First Pacific has a strong sell on the stock, although some other analysts have not been so bearish.

C-C Amatil, about 36 percent owned by The Coca-Cola Co, reported a slight rise in net profit to A$142.1 million for the 1996 year, compared with A$138.6 million a year earlier. The shares have fallen from a closing high of A$18.00 in October before the company issued a profit forecast downgrade in November.
